item.title: NAMM 2026: Aguilar Supercharges Octamizer and TLC Compressor with DLX Upgrades
item.description: Aguilar debuts the Octamizer DLX and TLC DLX Compressor EQ at NAMM 2026. The new DLX pedals add DSP-powered tracking, octave-up capability, and 3-band EQ. Both are available now for $329.99.

item.title: Flea Reimagines Frank Ocean’s “Thinkin Bout You” as a Cinematic Bass & Trumpet Ballad
item.description: Flea has released an orchestral instrumental version of Frank Ocean’s “Thinkin Bout You,” the third single from his upcoming solo album Honora. Listen and see tour dates.

item.title: Live Fusion Pocket: Wes Stephenson Drives “Lotus” with the Mark Lettieri Group
item.description: On “Lotus,” the Mark Lettieri Group lean into groove, powered by Wes Stephenson’s 5 string bass, full bodied tone, and fluid blend of fingerstyle and slap technique.

item.title: Washburn Revives the Wing Series with the Return of the Scavenger ’78 Bass
item.description: Washburn has revived its Wing Series with the return of the Scavenger ’78 Bass. Featuring mahogany construction and a classic P-style pickup, the vintage-inspired model lands at $699.

item.title: Donny Benét Drops "il Basso," a Groove-Driven Love Letter to the Bass
item.description: Donny Benét releases "Il Basso," a new album celebrating the bass guitar with nods to Paul Jackson, Bernard Edwards, Jaco Pastorius, and more. Watch the videos for “School’s Out” and “Midnight Appointment.”

item.title: Jack Bruce Commands Cream’s Royal Albert Hall “Stormy Monday” in Newly Released 2005 Footage
item.description: Jack Bruce’s Warwick fretless and Hartke rig take center stage in this newly released Cream performance of “Stormy Monday” at Royal Albert Hall.

item.title: Sire’s High-End F10, ESP’s NAMM Drop & Lettuce’s Erick Coomes Lead This Week’s Top 10
item.description: Sire’s premium F10 expansion, ESP’s new LTD DX basses, Erick Coomes with Lettuce, and more lead this week’s most-read stories on No Treble.

item.title: Björn Meyer Expands the Language of Solo Electric Bass on "Convergence"
item.description: Björn Meyer releases "Convergence", a live-in-studio solo bass album featuring new six-string techniques, real-time effects, and magnetic string experiments.

item.title: Angine de Poitrine Deliver a Bizarre, Microtonal Instrumental Storm on KEXP
item.description: Angine de Poitrine bring microtonal grooves, looping textures, and double-neck bass and guitar to a KEXP session that defies easy labels.

item.title: Bass of the Week: Spector’s One-of-One 50th Anniversary Bass Stuns with Full-Fingerboard Inlay
item.description: Built on the NS-5 platform, Spector’s 50th Anniversary Custom Shop bass showcases master-grade maple and a historic inlay spanning the entire fingerboard.
